development_findings: The hand-rolled stdlib predictor decode was FALSIFIED by the tifffile cross-check: four byte-lane accumulate variants x two byte orders all mismatched the authoritative decoder on the pinned grids. tifffile (already in the venv, plus imagecodecs for the float predictor) is now the authoritative reader; the synthetic writer encodes via imagecodecs.floatpred_encode so the round trip is exact by construction.

Three derivation corrections landed pre-freeze, each falsified by a test before the law was fixed: (1) the banked holdout bound (|dxx|+|dyy|)/8 was off by 2x and vacuous as stated; the implemented law asserts the exact discrete identity axial_mean-node=(d2x+d2y)/4 and REPORTS the bilinear remainder bar (|f_xx|+|f_yy|)/8; (2) an intermediate axial-vs-diagonal 'theorem' was falsified by the x^2*y^2 surface and discarded; (3) the TIFF tiepoint check read world coordinates where the raster side belongs.
The EGM08 artifact needed the intake cap raised 64->128 MB (resource limit, not a law; reason recorded in pipeline.py). The SI token vocabulary gained 'degree' for the geoid spacing record.

The planarity gate refuses honestly: El Yunque's 24.2 deg slope is refused as a flat-plane admission -- steep terrain needs its own tilted-surface qualification, which this slice deliberately does not claim.
